# BITTIME

> > A leading Indonesian cryptocurrency exchange platform offering real-time market data, staking, OTC trading, and educational resources in IDR and USDT.

BITTIME is a comprehensive crypto trading and investment platform designed for Indonesian users, providing market access, passive income opportunities through staking, and educational content for both beginners and experienced traders.

## Key Topics

- Cryptocurrency Exchange
- Real-time Pricing
- IDR/USDT Trading
- Staking & APY Returns
- OTC Trading
- Token Airdrops
- Proof of Stake
- KYC Verification
- Investment Education
- Crypto Market Data
- Referral Program
- Indonesian Rupiah
- USDT
- zkSync
- PALAPA Token

## Market & Pricing

- [Harga Crypto Hari Ini | IDR & USDT | BITTIME](https://www.bittime.com/market): Real-time cryptocurrency market prices in IDR and USDT with 24-hour data

## Trading & Investment Services

- [Bursa Kripto | Beli & Jual Aset | Bursa Mata Uang Kripto | Bittime](https://www.bittime.com/staking): Staking and passive income platform supporting 200+ crypto assets with APY returns
- [Bursa Kripto | Beli & Jual Aset | Bursa Mata Uang Kripto | Bittime](https://www.bittime.com/otc): OTC trading service for buying and selling 200+ crypto assets with fast transactions

## Education & Learning

- [Panduan Lengkap: Cara Trading & Investasi Aset Kripto | Bittime Edukasi](https://www.bittime.com/education): Educational guides and tutorials for crypto trading, investing, and blockchain

- [Airdrop PALAPA: Dapatkan Airdrop Token PALAPA Gratis Sekarang! - Bittime](https://www.bittime.com/airdrop/palapa): PALAPA token airdrop campaign with limited-time free token distribution opportunity
- [Airdrop ZKSYNC: Dapatkan Airdrop Token ZKSYNC Gratis Sekarang! - Bittime](https://www.bittime.com/airdrop/zkSync): zkSync token airdrop campaign offering free tokens and referral rewards
